name: Pyromancer Flaming Finesse raises Seal effectiveness by 20% (#3103)
contract: #3103: Flaming Finesse 706878 effect 2 is aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) bp 19 (+20%) on SpellClassMask (0x10000,0,0), family 30, which covers the Seal of Alysrazor / Seal of Al'ar ranks (800196, 803649 ...). SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue applies the caster's ALL_EFFECTS mod through Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, so it works with no module code. Al'ar 803649 effect 1 (aura 85, base 10) is asserted through spell_effect_value at 1.2x its value without 706878; Alysrazor 800196 (base value only 2, too small to show 20%) is asserted through the spell_modifier probe on op 8. Values from inv-group-8.md and Spell.dbc.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Seal of Al'ar effect 1 is 20% stronger (ALL_EFFECTS +20 on family-30 flag 0x10000)
Seal of Alysrazor ALL_EFFECTS modifier is +20%
Removing the passive removes the bonus
